title: Ruleset: boosted_moves
description: rules/<id>/boosted_moves.yaml: the one technique each species fights with boosted as a partner, an engine improvement behind the boosted techniques option (packages/game/battle: BoostedMoveRules, docs/modules/game/battle.md). Enemies never use it.

power_percent.description: The boosted technique's power in percent of the table's, rounded down.

mp_cost_percent.description: The boosted technique's MP cost in percent of the table's, rounded up; a technique that costs MP never becomes free.

species.description: Species id -> the id of its boosted technique (data/moves), one it can learn (the species table's moves).
